plain_english_policy: Support marriage promotion programs for welfare recipients.

effects.rationale: Marriage promotion programs may restrict access to certain benefits or services for unmarried individuals.
Supporting marriage promotion could lead to stricter enforcement of family support policies, particularly those related to child custody and visitation rights.

evidence_quote: "I believe that promoting stable marriages can help reduce poverty among families." - [Source: Candidate's Statement on Welfare Policy]" (verbatim substring of the source text).
